tasks.title: Should the org's other member be able to read one-job-private?
tasks.description:
🟡 #45 · One other person can read the private repo: intended?

Coral's rec: Restrict it unless you meant it. That member is one of the people the roster describes. Setting base permissions to "No permission" affects every repo in the organisation, so check what else they need first; the narrower fix is to move the private repo to your personal account.

tasks.title: In the Todoist model, does your deck follow the list's order, or keep its own?
tasks.description:
🟡 #40 · Agent's deck: does the deck follow the list's order, or keep its own?

Coral's rec: Keep its own. The top card is what the app protects, and "Later" has to mean something. New tasks would join behind the top card, as Siri's do. Two smaller questions are in the write-up (answering from a card; whether this replaces R4.1 and R4.3).
